source_of_source_en: QUESTION_SPECIFICITY_AND_ADAPTIVE_FOLLOWUP_MATRIX.md from CUST03 recovery candidate, not released instrument
source_option_codes: CUST03 frozen candidate; exact codes verified against matrix
draft_labels_note: English display labels and Bahasa Melayu labels are reviewer drafts, not frozen original labels. Source stems are included separately.

questions.title: Area relationship / Hubungan dengan kawasan
questions.source_en_stem: Which of the following describe your connection to [named area]? Select all that apply. If none apply, select one of: Rarely, Never, Not sure.
questions.draft_en_stem: Which of the following describe your connection to [named area]? Select all that apply. If none apply, select one of the remaining alternatives.
questions.draft_bm_stem: Antara yang berikut, yang manakah menerangkan hubungan anda dengan [nama kawasan]? Pilih semua yang berkenaan. Jika tiada yang berkenaan, pilih satu daripada pilihan selebihnya.

options.draft_en_label: I operate a business in this area
options.draft_bm_label: Saya menjalankan perniagaan di kawasan ini

options.draft_en_label: I visit this area for activities or other purposes
options.draft_bm_label: Saya datang ke kawasan ini untuk aktiviti atau tujuan lain

questions.review_notes: RARELY has no defined period or count; historical terminal codes are retained. A revision must not silently redefine them.

questions.title: Days physically present / Hari berada di kawasan
questions.source_en_stem: In the last four weeks, on how many days were you physically present in [named area]? Please count each day once, even if you were there more than once that day.
questions.draft_en_stem: In the last four weeks, on how many different days were you physically present in [named area]? Count each day only once, even if you visited more than once.
questions.draft_bm_stem: Dalam tempoh empat minggu yang lalu, pada berapa hari yang berbeza anda berada secara fizikal di [nama kawasan]? Kira setiap hari sekali sahaja, walaupun anda datang lebih daripada sekali.
questions.review_notes: Days are not visits; no distinct recall-difficulty response is present in this bank.

questions.title: Hypothetical journey origin / Tempat permulaan perjalanan
questions.source_en_stem: If you decided to visit the café described above, where would you most likely begin that journey?
questions.draft_en_stem: If you decided to visit the café described above, where would you most likely begin that journey?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Jika anda memutuskan untuk mengunjungi kafe yang diterangkan di atas, dari manakah kemungkinan besar anda akan memulakan perjalanan tersebut?
questions.review_notes: Hypothetical origin type, not a district, location, distance or real trip.

questions.title: Existing café purchase occasions / Kekerapan pembelian di kafe sedia ada
questions.source_en_stem: In the past 30 days, on how many occasions have you bought food or a drink from an existing café?
questions.draft_en_stem: In the past 30 days, on how many occasions have you bought food or a drink from an existing café?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Dalam tempoh 30 hari yang lalu, berapa kali anda membeli makanan atau minuman daripada kafe yang sedia ada?
questions.review_notes: Historical seven-day versus candidate 30-day window and definition of occasion require scientific reconciliation.

questions.title: Stated future visiting intention / Niat berkunjung
questions.source_en_stem: If the café described in [concept_card_version] opened in [named area], how likely would you be to visit it at least once during its first three months?
questions.draft_en_stem: If the café described above opened in [named area], how likely would you be to visit it at least once during its first three months?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Jika kafe yang diterangkan di atas dibuka di [nama kawasan], sejauh manakah kemungkinan anda akan mengunjunginya sekurang-kurangnya sekali dalam tempoh tiga bulan pertama selepas pembukaannya?
questions.review_notes: Pasti akan/tidak akan may imply commitment; approved versioned concept card required. UNSURE is substantive in the original candidate; CANNOT_JUDGE is not.

questions.title: Proposed menu-category interest / Minat terhadap kategori menu
questions.source_en_stem: Which of the following categories from this proposed café menu would you be interested in? Select up to three.
questions.draft_en_stem: Which of the following categories from this proposed café menu would you be interested in? Select up to three.
questions.draft_bm_stem: Antara kategori berikut dalam menu kafe yang dicadangkan, yang manakah menarik minat anda? Pilih sehingga tiga kategori.
questions.review_notes: Selection cap and exclusive NONE/other handling require reconciliation; no additional free-text response is assumed.

questions.title: Exact-offer price acceptability / Penerimaan harga tawaran khusus
questions.source_en_stem: How acceptable would paying [exact_rm_price] for [one_exact_product_size_quantity_fulfilment_and_charges] at the proposed café be to you?
questions.draft_en_stem: How acceptable would paying [exact RM price] for [exact product, size, quantity, service method and charges] at the proposed café be to you?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Sejauh manakah harga [harga tepat dalam RM] boleh anda terima untuk [produk, saiz, kuantiti, kaedah perkhidmatan dan caj yang dinyatakan dengan tepat] di kafe yang dicadangkan?
questions.review_notes: Berkecuali midpoint equivalence requires pretesting. Missing exact approved offer makes Q07 NOT_SHOWN.

questions.title: Past café visiting occasions / Situasi kunjungan kafe terdahulu
questions.source_en_stem: Thinking only about the existing-café visits you reported in the past 30 days, on which occasions did you visit a café? Select all that apply.
questions.draft_en_stem: Thinking only about the existing-café visits you reported in the past 30 days, on which occasions did you visit a café? Select all that apply.
questions.draft_bm_stem: Dengan merujuk hanya kepada kunjungan ke kafe sedia ada yang anda laporkan dalam tempoh 30 hari lalu, dalam situasi manakah anda mengunjungi kafe? Pilih semua yang berkenaan.

options.draft_en_label: While studying or taking a study break
options.draft_bm_label: Semasa belajar atau berehat daripada belajar

options.draft_en_label: To meet or spend time with others
options.draft_bm_label: Untuk berjumpa atau meluangkan masa bersama orang lain
Semasa dalam perjalanan atau melalui kawasan tersebut

questions.review_notes: Past existing-café occasions, not hypothetical Q09. Source occasion bank is provisional.

questions.title: Hypothetical future occasions / Situasi kemungkinan kunjungan akan datang
questions.source_en_stem: If you visited this proposed café, on which occasions might you choose to visit? Select all that apply.
questions.draft_en_stem: If you visited this proposed café, on which occasions might you choose to visit? Select all that apply.
questions.draft_bm_stem: Sekiranya anda mengunjungi kafe yang dicadangkan ini, dalam situasi manakah anda mungkin memilih untuk datang? Pilih semua yang berkenaan.

options.draft_en_label: While studying or taking a study break
options.draft_bm_label: Semasa belajar atau berehat daripada belajar

options.draft_en_label: To meet or spend time with others
options.draft_bm_label: Untuk berjumpa atau meluangkan masa bersama orang lain
Semasa dalam perjalanan atau melalui kawasan tersebut

questions.review_notes: Hypothetical, not past or actual future visits. Occasion bank and OPEN_ROUTING_01 remain unapproved.

questions.title: Importance of café features / Kepentingan ciri kafe
questions.source_en_stem: For each feature of the described café, how important would that feature be to you if you chose to visit?
questions.draft_en_stem: For each feature of the described café, how important would that feature be to you if you chose to visit?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Bagi setiap ciri kafe yang diterangkan, sejauh manakah pentingnya ciri tersebut kepada anda sekiranya anda memilih untuk mengunjunginya?
questions.review_notes: Adjacent Malay intensity labels require expert validation; source feature bank is null and OPEN_ROUTING_02 unresolved. No composite/causal score.

questions.title: Preferred service format / Pilihan kaedah perkhidmatan
questions.source_en_stem: For the proposed café offer, which service format would you mainly choose?
questions.draft_en_stem: For the proposed café offer, which service format would you mainly choose?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Bagi tawaran kafe yang dicadangkan, kaedah perkhidmatan yang manakah akan menjadi pilihan utama anda?
questions.review_notes: Optional research-only; no accepted A10 report destination.

questions.title: Usual transport to the area / Pengangkutan biasa ke kawasan
questions.source_en_stem: What is your usual way of travelling to [named area]?
questions.draft_en_stem: What is your usual way of travelling to [named area]?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Apakah kaedah pengangkutan yang biasanya anda gunakan untuk pergi ke [nama kawasan]?
questions.review_notes: Usual has no defined timeframe; OTHER lacks a coding scheme. This is transport to area, not café-trip transport.

questions.title: Expected price band / Julat harga dijangka
questions.source_en_stem: What would you expect to pay for [defined item: medium latte, dine-in]?
questions.draft_en_stem: What would you expect to pay for [defined medium latte, dine-in]?
questions.draft_bm_stem: Berapakah harga yang anda jangkakan untuk [latte saiz sederhana yang diminum di premis seperti yang ditakrifkan]?
questions.review_notes: Expected price is not Q07 price acceptability; explicit numeric band-edge definition is still pending.
